svg.aria-label: Fig 1 - Cost of K, indexed within each configuration
svg.text: Fig 1 - Cost of K, indexed within each configuration
Each series indexed to its panel's smallest shared K. x = K (log2), y = log. Flat means K is free; rising means K dominates.
global-map K sweep (caustic K pinned at 1)
caustic-map K sweep (global K pinned at 24)
x below axis = run did not finish. K=256 fails with CUDA error 718 on every configuration (sticky fault, real cause is the gather kernel).
Sweeps against an empty photon map (cornell-box caustic, sponza caustic) are excluded -- they measure nothing.
Each series is normalised to its own anchor, so the gap between the two lines compares growth, not cost. For cost, see fig 2.
